abstract: Run AnythingLLM, the all-in-one chat, RAG and agent app, against self-hosted LLM servers. Covers the persistent Docker install, Generic OpenAI, Ollama, LiteLLM and LocalAI providers with env variable names, key and custom-header handling, model-name and context-window settings, recipes for vLLM, llama.cpp, llama-swap, LiteLLM and Ollama, @agent tool calling (native versus prompt-based), MCP servers and troubleshooting, with an env template and a read-only endpoint probe script.
